extra.final_summary:
Average body mass by species (grams, 52 rows used): Adelie 3848.91, Chinstrap 3721.43, Gentoo 5181.82.

Problems found and fixes applied:
1. body_mass_g was stored as text, including one value written as "5,500" (row 44). Cast to numbers — all 53 values parsed, none lost.
2. Row 10 had body_mass_g = 4,000,000 g, far outside the rules range of 2500–6500 g (almost certainly a typo). Excluded that row (approved); it would otherwise have inflated the Adelie average enormously.
3. Checked species labels (no variants/misspellings), missing species values (none) and exact duplicate rows (none) — no action needed.

Caveats: the excluded row is dropped rather than corrected, since the true mass is unknown; Adelie now averages over 23 rows instead of 24. Columns not used by this question (island, sex, bill/flipper measurements) were left untouched — note island has label variants ("Torgerson", "Bisco") and sex has case variants ("MALE"/"FEMALE") that would need cleaning for any analysis grouped by those columns.
